id.description: For internal use only! The ID (GUID) to assign to the newly created Object.

type.description: The type of the new object. Refer to \ref wobjects_index for possible object types.

name.description: The name of the new object.

notes.description: The notes or comments of the new object.

parent.description: The ID (GUID), name, or path of the parent of the new object.

list.description: The name of the list in which to insert the object. If this argument is set, the object gets inserted in a list owned by the parent and not as a child.

platform.description: The ID (GUID) or unique name of the platform used when setting properties via this command. Not specifying a platform sets the value for all linked platforms.

autoAddToSourceControl.description: Determines if Wwise automatically performs an Add source control operation for affected work units. Defaults to true.

onNameConflict.description: The action to take if "parent" already has a child with the same name. Default value is "fail". Refer to \ref waapi_create_objects_modes for more information.

^@[:_a-zA-Z0-9]+$.description: Sets the value of property \@propertyName. Refer to \ref wobjects_index for property names.
